export_review.decision: Structural derivation, exact source/Git blob hashes, retained notices, repository split separation, exposure repository exclusion and deterministic exact/near deduplication checked. Source-only training protocol approved; original issue-family protocol remains unready.

label_policy: The maintained docstring's association with its own function is a structural positive. Other functions may be in-batch contrastive candidates; they are unjudged pseudo-negatives with false-negative risk, never independent semantic-negative labels.
limitations: Function counts are not independent issue families or repaired tasks.
One repository per split confounds language style, library domain and repository identity; this is a small transfer pilot.
Public source may have been seen during pretrained encoder training; base-model contamination is unknown.
No repair model training, test execution, official benchmark score or cloud upload is established.
Licensing review is bound to exact acquired repository license notices; no GitHub issue or dataset rights are inferred.
protocol: Source-only maintained docstring-to-function retrieval; repository-disjoint splits fixed before extraction. No issue-family or repair claims.
